{{Quote|I am Lonay, son of Mogra'daal, nothing but a clanless wanderer in the sea of stars.|Decorative Twi'leki pictograph adorning Lonay's lekku|<ref name="The Regalia of Office" />}}
'''Mogra'daal''' was a [[Parent/Legends|parent]] of the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Lonay]].

A gossip circulating among Lonay's underlings went that his father was a [[Clan Chief]], obsessed with flashy works of art, and he sold Lonay to [[slavery/Legends|slavery]] to pay for his collection.<ref>''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>
